description.zh:
标准型和尊享型企业版实例下，可开启自定义Topic数据压缩或解压缩。
取值：

- **compress**：压缩。
- **decompress**：解压缩。

数据压缩功能详细内容，请参见[数据压缩](~~477405~~)。

><notice>**TopicShortName**传入通配符（`+`和`#`）时，不可同时传入**Codec**。如果创建通配Topic类的同时，开启了数据压缩或解压缩功能，调用本接口创建该Topic类会失败。
></notice>
description.en:
For medium and premium Enterprise instances, you can enable data compression or decompression for custom topics.  
Valid values:  

- **compress**: Compress.  
- **decompress**: Decompress.  

For more information about data compression, see [Data Compression](~~477405~~).  

><notice>When **TopicShortName** contains wildcard characters (`+` or `#`), you cannot specify **Codec** at the same time. If you attempt to create a wildcard topic category while enabling data compression or decompression, the call to this API will fail.  
></notice>

description.zh: Topic类的描述信息。长度限制为100字符（一个汉字占一个字符）。
description.en: The description of the topic category. The description must be 1 to 100 characters in length.

description.zh:
**Operation**为**SUB**（订阅）或**ALL**（发布和订阅），可开启代理订阅。
取值：

- **true**：开启。
- **false**：不开启。

开启代理订阅后，设备与物联网平台建连时，物联网平台查询已开启代理订阅的Topic，帮助设备完成订阅。
description.en:
If **Operation** is set to **SUB** (subscribe) or **ALL** (publish and subscribe), you can enable proxy subscription.  
Valid values:  

- **true**: Enabled.  
- **false**: Disabled.  

After proxy subscription is enabled, when a device establishes a connection with the IoT Platform, the platform queries all topics with proxy subscription enabled and helps the device complete the subscription.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
设备对该Topic类的操作权限，取值：

- **SUB**：订阅。
- **PUB**：发布。
- **ALL**：发布和订阅。
description.en:
The operation permissions of the device on the topic category. Valid values:

*   **SUB**: Subscribe.
*   **PUB**: Publish.
*   **ALL**: Publish and Subscribe.

description.zh:
要修改的Topic类的ID。
调用[CreateProductTopic](~~69649~~)接口创建自定义Topic类成功后，返回的**TopicId**。
description.en: The ID of the topic category that you want to modify.

description.zh:
设置Topic类的自定义类目名称。Topic类默认包含_productKey_和_deviceName_两级类目，类目间以正斜线（/）分隔，其格式为：`productKey/deviceName/topicShortName`。

> 每级类目的名称只能包含字母、数字和下划线（_），且不能为空。
description.en:
The name of the user-defined category level that you want to set. By default, a topic category includes the following levels: \_productkey\_ and \_devicename\_. Separate the two levels with slashes (/). Format of a topic category: `productKey/deviceName/topicShortName`.

>  Each level can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_), and cannot be empty.

title.zh: 更新指定的产品自定义Topic类
title.en: Update a Custom Topic Category of a Specified Product

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。

 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 50.

 > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-product-topic --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --desc resubmit_a_test_topic --operation PUB --topic-short-name resubmit --topic-id 8210000 --enable-proxy-subscribe false --codec compress --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateProductTopic --region cn-hangzhou --Desc resubmit_a_test_topic --Codec compress --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --TopicShortName resubmit --EnableProxySubscribe false --TopicId 8210000 --Operation PUB
